node.statement: Concrete independence witness: keep every currently allowed object and all level-one forms fixed, and for one n>1 replace only the otherwise unconstrained named amplified sesquilinear form by <Y,V>_n prime := 2*sum_i<Y_i,V_i>. This remains a sesquilinear form and violates neither def-ha-map (which is level one) nor def-hcb-datum (which supplies an amplified form without a coordinate normalization), nor the amplified-compression dependency. Yet sum_i<Y_i,V_i>=(1/2)<Y,V>_n prime, so the coefficient-one formula is false in this model. Thus it is not derivable from the permitted inputs and explicit definition/dependency provisioning is mathematically necessary.
